summary: This note is a wiki-style biography of Tom Nicholls, a professional Australian rules footballer who plays for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League. It covers his path to the club as an underage recruit, his place in the Gold Coast's first season, and his AFL debut in Round 8 of 2011, in which he faced his girlfriend's brother, Kurt Tippett.
one_line: Tom Nicholls is an Australian rules footballer for the Gold Coast Football Club who debuted in Round 8 of the 2011 AFL season.
